interface.alternative: Accessible HTML links and readable evidence entries

interface.principle: Visual prominence, distance and connectivity do not establish truth or guilt.

evidence_standards: Stable claim identifiers and exact source locators
Separate allegations, findings, observations and interpretations
Document wording does not prove the claimed capability
Repeated reporting is not independent corroboration
No diagnosis, body-language lie detection or guilt by association

contributions.workflow_scope: Version-controlled proposals, exact-hash separate editorial records and correction history; no automatic acceptance or issue importer; profile labels are not authenticated real-world identities
